newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkey says 24 killed in rebel Kurd fight.
newsitem.headline: Turkey says 24 killed in rebel Kurd fight.

text.p: Turkish troops have killed 18 rebel Kurds in recent clashes in eastern Turkey, the state-run Anatolian news agency said on Thursday.

The emergency rule governor's office in the southeastern city of Diyarbakir said six soldiers had also been killed in the clashes, which took place in five provinces. It did not say when the fighting happened.
The news agency said 13 rebels of the Kurdistan Workers Party (PKK) were killed in the eastern province of Van after crossing the border from Iran to attack a Turkish police post.
A number of guerrillas later slipped back into Iran under the cover of darkness, Anatolian said.

Turkey accuses neighbours Iran and Syria of sponsoring the PKK but Islamist Prime Minister Necmettin Erbakan said during a visit to Iran last month that Tehran had assured him it was not supporting the separatist group.
Reports of clashes in Van have been on the rise in recent weeks.
More than 20,000 people have been killed in the 12-year-old struggle between the Turkish army and the PKK which wants autonomy or independence in southeast Turkey.
